title: Tessl Academy: Learn AI Coding On Your Own Codebase
description:
Most agentic coding tutorials fall apart the moment you leave the video and open your own repo. Tessl Academy is a hands-on curriculum built to fix that — every lesson runs live inside the coding agent you already use, on your own code.

What we cover:
– Why most AI coding tutorials don't survive contact with your own codebase
– Writing your first agent skill and watching it get used unprompted
– Scoring a skill with agent evaluation before you trust it
– Teaching your reviewer agent the conventions your team already has
– Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Tessl — bring whatever you use

To get started for free with Tessl Academy, go to:
https://tessl.co/9w6
